card.name: Beta-lactam antibiotic contraindication wording
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, other, to, and) in hypersensitivity statements about beta-lactam or cephalosporin antibiotics, and inside names like ceftazidime, avibactam and aztreonam in dosing lines.
